meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents... “Tuscan Blue,” a charming carriage house in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Just a 2-min walk to the pristine sugar-white sands and 1 min from the Coquina Pool, this stylish retreat offers a well-appointed kitchen, a cozy living and sleeping
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... “Tuscan Blue,” a charming carriage house in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Just a 2-min walk to the pristine sugar-white sands and 1 min from the Coquina Pool, this stylish retreat offers a well-appointed kitchen, a cozy living and sleeping spaces, a Tesla charging station, and 3 bikes to explore 30A with ease. Ideal for a small family or a couples’ getaway. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location: 2-minutes from Rosemary Beach’s emerald waters and 1 minute from Coquina PoolTesla Charging Station: Convenient onsite charging for eco-conscious travelersCharming Comfort: Cozy living spaces with natural light, a private balcony, and modern amenitiesWell-Appointed Kitchen: Fully equipped for all your cooking needsConvenient Sleeping Arrangements: Primary with King and 2 Queens set up as bunks in the second bedroomBikes Included: Explore the area with 3 beach bikes includedOutdoor Enclosed Area: Dine al-fresco and rinse with a heated outdoor shower after a perfect day at the beachEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Proximity to the pool and beach was excellent. Perfect for our family of four!" – Marcie M.⭐"The perfect setup for a weekend getaway with a fantastic location." – Robyn S.⭐"Loved the natural light and thoughtful touches. Plan to stay here again!" – Blair T.*** LIVING AREA ***Settle into the bright and airy living area, complete with large windows that bathe the space in natural light. The cozy layout features a comfortable couch, a dining table for 6, and a fully equipped kitchen perfect for whipping up breakfast before hitting the beach. The balcony, just off the living area, is an idyllic spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening with a views of the Coquina Pool nearby.Spacious living area with natural lightComfortable seating arrangement and smart TV for movie nightsBalcony with seating for four*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The kitchen is thoughtfully designed with everything you need, including modern appliances, efficient storage, and sleek countertops to prepare meals with ease. The dining area is ideal for a quick breakfast or shared family dinner.Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliancesDining table for 6 suitable for family meals with kidsCoffee maker and all essential cookware included*** OUTDOOR AREA ***“Tuscan Blue” offers both convenience and charm with its thoughtfully planned outdoor spaces. A ground-level seating area is perfect for al fresco dining in a shade of the trees, while under-stairs access leads to a refreshing outdoor shower after beach outings.Outdoor dining area with a table for sixOutdoor shower for your post-beach refreshTesla charging station for guest use*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Sleeping arrangements are modern and comfortable, offering two cozy bedrooms designed for relaxation.Primary King Suite: Serene king-size bed with balcony access and a smart TV for entertainmentBunk Room: Queen-over-queen bunk beds, perfect for kids or close friendsBathroom with glass-enclosed shower and all essentials*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located on the south side of Rosemary Beach, Tuscan Blue offers easy access to boutique shops, top-rated dining, and plenty of activities. Rosemary Beach is more than a destination—it’s an experience. With award-winning architecture, hidden boardwalks, and endless charm, it’s the perfect getaway. The emerald water makes for stunning family photos, while breathtaking sunsets create peaceful evenings. With 2.3 miles of footpaths and lush green spaces, every moment in Rosemary Beach is unforgettable.2-Min Walk to Beach Access with restrooms1-Min Walk to Coquina Pool5-Min Stroll to High-End Shops and Fine DiningRosemary Beach Community: Beachside Destination with Award-Winning ArchitectureMultiple Parks & Greens: Playgrounds, Splash Pad, Butterfly Park, Boardwalks, and FountainsClose to Alys Beach and Pier Park4 RESORT POOLS:Barbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 3 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.Guests are permitted to only one parking spot in front of the garage door. Additional street parking can be found throughout Rosemary.There is an active camera at the property facing the stairs, patio, and courtyard.Discount and Promotion Restrictions Apply.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
